question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I didn't knew that she was coming to your house.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb **"knew" after "didn't".**
 
• In negative sentences with "didn't", the base form of the verb should be used.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "I didn't know", **ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I** didn't know** that she was coming to your house."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "coming to your house."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "that she was"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
